title: Findings document
description: What an interrogation emits. The authoritative representation of findings; any markdown view is generated from this and not committed.

charter-version.description: The charter in force. A findings document is uninterpretable without it.

pack-version.description: The stack pack in force, or null for a solution that consumes none.

round.description: Interrogation round. Round 2+ interrogates repair diffs, not the whole artifact.

failed-checks.description: Every check that failed in this run. PROVENANCE, and the reason a check citation stays auditable: `{kind:'check', id:'x'}` asserts that x FAILED, which is a property of the run rather than of the artifact — so without this list nothing downstream can tell a real citation from a plausible-looking one. The workflow emitted this field before the schema allowed it, which made every real interrogation document invalid; nothing noticed because nothing validated one.

rejected-citations.description: Citations an agent named that did not resolve, and were therefore dropped — leaving the finding at `suggested`. Recorded rather than swallowed: a role that keeps naming checks which did not fail is producing plausible noise, which is exactly what the amendment signals want to know.

cycleId.description: yyyymmdd-hhhh. Identity, not ordering; assigned once and never reused.

category.description: Owned by the charter. Eleven values as of charter v1.

state.description: open is pending triage; blocking must resolve before landing; suggested never halts.

stage.description: Which artifact should have prevented this. May be upstream of the target.

detection.description: check means a mechanical check failed and is deterministic; reasoning means an agent inferred it.

anchor.description: A heading or a uniquely-quoted string. Never a line number: a line number is invalidated by any edit above it, and an anchor survives.

cite.description: Exactly one of four kinds. A finding cannot reach blocking without at least one.

repair.description: A concrete change that would resolve this. Its presence is what makes a blocking finding self-healable.

allOf.$comment: RULE 1 — the anti-inflation guard. blocking requires at least one citation, so an uncited blocking finding cannot be emitted at all.
RULE 2 — unclassified can never block. Its rate is a health metric for the taxonomy, so it must never be able to halt a cycle.
RULE 3 — mechanical findings skip triage. A failed check IS the citation, so a check-detected finding is born blocking and never sits at open.
RULE 4 — a location-pair citation is permitted only for internal-contradiction. A contradiction you can point at both halves of is self-evident; nothing else is.
RULE 5 — rejected and accepted-wont-fix must say why. They feed opposite amendment signals, so an unexplained one corrupts the evidence.
